description: Pro. Find templates that drift. Crawls the site from `url` (same origin only, up to 40 pages, 4 requests at a time, or only the `paths` you list), uses sitemap.xml to find pages, and obeys robots.txt for the user agent ATPDesigners. Reads static HTML only. The result opens with coverage: pages read of pages found, which were skipped or truncated, and requests used. Treats the most common version of each area as the baseline and lists the pages that differ: primary nav links, header and footer markup, footer links, stylesheet set, h1 class, button and link text written several ways, html lang and icons.

maxPages.description: Optional lower page cap. The hard cap is 40 pages.

paths.description: Optional list of same-origin paths such as /about. When given, only these pages are read and links are not followed.

sitemap.description: Use sitemap.xml to find pages. Default true.

url.description: Home page or any page on the site. The crawl stays on this origin.

name: site_consistency
title: Site consistency
